description.zh: 节点高级配置。取值为JSON字符串格式。
description.en: The advanced configuration for the node. The value of this parameter must be a JSON string.

description.zh: 任务节点ID，可调用[GetTaskInstanceRelation](~~424711~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the task node. You can call the [GetTaskInstanceRelation](~~424711~~) operation to query the node ID.

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)或[ListUserTenants](~~198074~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to query the tenant ID.

descriptions.zh: 调用此接口也可以配置失败任务、重跑任务。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation to configure a failed task or rerun a task.
